questions.question: What does cosine similarity measure?
choices: The Euclidean distance between two vectors
The angle between two vectors (direction similarity)
The magnitude difference between two vectors
questions.explanation: Cosine similarity measures the cosine of the angle between vectors, capturing direction similarity regardless of magnitude.

questions.question: Why is normalization critical for cosine similarity?
choices: Without it, vectors of different magnitudes give different similarity scores even if pointing in the same direction
It converts negative values to positive
It's required by the JavaScript Math library
questions.explanation: Normalization ensures that [1,0] and [100,0] (same direction, different magnitude) produce the same similarity score, which is correct behavior.

questions.question: What should cosineSimilarity return when one vector is all zeros?
questions.explanation: A zero vector has no direction, so similarity is undefined. Returning 0 is the safe default to avoid NaN in downstream calculations.
